item.text:
**8B.5 Research Note (Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, 2024)**

Bottom line: **mixed, leaning negative**. Erdoğan’s state showed real internal coordination in a few high-capacity lanes, especially macro stabilization, budget programming, and rule-based procurement. But in other domains the pattern was **selective coercive control, weak accountability, and uneven follow-through**, especially toward opposition-held localities and crisis transparency. Some positive items below are **inferences** from formal planning/implementation documents rather than direct proof of personal managerial skill.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable page URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|

Cumhurbaşkanlığı Strateji ve Bütçe Başkanlığı | 2024-01-26 | https://www.sbb.gov.tr/2024-yili-yatirim-programi-yayimlandi/ | The 2024 investment program was signed by Erdoğan, prioritized disaster-risk and high-impact projects, and allocated TL 1,006.9 billion across 12,041 projects. This is strong evidence of centralized budgetary follow-through. | 8B.5; 8B.2 |

This is direct evidence of an execution framework, though not proof that all ministries complied equally well. | 8B.5; 8B.2 |
| Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası Başkanlığı Atamasına İlişkin Basın Duyurusu | Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye | 2024-02-04 | https://www.tcmb.gov.tr/wps/wcm/connect/en/tcmb%2Ben/main%2Bmenu/announcements/press%2Breleases/2024/ano2024-06 | Erdoğan appointed Fatih Karahan, a professional economist and deputy governor, as central bank governor, and the bank framed the mandate around price stability and disinflation. This supports competence-based staffing in a critical institution. | 8B.5; 8B.4 |
| 1.1 Governing Bodies - TCMB 2024 Annual Report | Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye | 2024 | https://www3.tcmb.gov.tr/yillikrapor/2024/en/m-1-1/ | The Monetary Policy Committee is a formal body of named economists and academics with a price-stability mandate and recorded resolutions. That is evidence of institutionalized internal coordination in macro policy. | 8B.5; 8B.4 |
| Foreword by Director General | Devlet Malzeme Ofisi Genel Müdürlüğü | 2024-05-03 | https://www.dmo.gov.tr/Eng/Home/EngIcerik/1212 | The State Supply Office describes transparent, competitive, accountable e-procurement and a digitalized hospital-supplies channel. This is strong evidence that at least one large implementing agency was running on formal rules rather than pure patronage. | 8B.5; 8B.4 |
| Governor Fatih Karahan’s Speech at the Briefing on Inflation Report 2024-II | Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye | 2024-05-09 | https://www.tcmb.gov.tr/wps/wcm/connect/en/tcmb%20en/main%20menu/announcements/remarks%20by%20governor/2024/speechg09_05_2024 | The governor said fiscal policy and administered prices would support disinflation, implying cross-institution coordination behind the stabilization program. This is indirect evidence that the core economic team was aligned enough to sustain follow-through. | 8B.5; 8B.2 |

Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı | 2024-04-02 | https://guvenliinsaat.csgb.gov.tr/haberler/akkuyu-nukleer-guc-santrali-inşaatını-ziyaret-ettik/ | Labor inspectors visited Akkuyu and shared occupational-health and safety fixes. This is narrow but real evidence of disciplined administrative oversight around a strategic project. | 8B.5; 8B.4 |

This is strong evidence of blocked accountability and weak follow-through across the bureaucracy. | 8B.5; 7B.10 |

That points to deliberate opacity and poor institutional follow-through when scrutiny threatened officials. | 8B.5; 7B.10 |

This shows strong central control, but it also shows that coordination often operated through coercive substitution rather than neutral administrative continuity. | 8B.5; 8B.3 |
| Turkey blocks access to Instagram platform but gives no reason | Reuters | 2024-08-02 | https://theprint.in/world/turkey-blocks-access-to-instagram-platform-but-gives-no-reason/2204688/ | The state regulator blocked Instagram nationwide without giving a reason or duration. That is effective enforcement, but it cuts against transparent, predictable coordination across the state. | 8B.5; 7B.10 |
| Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says state media favored the AKP, speech was restricted, and the government interfered with media and assembly rights. This supports the reading that internal coordination often served regime protection, not neutral administration. | 8B.5; 7B.10 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find a single authoritative source that directly measures “internal discipline” across the entire Erdoğan governing network in one place.
- The best evidence is therefore **composite**: planning documents, the central bank, procurement, and oversight bodies on the positive side; mayor removals, secrecy around earthquake accountability, and digital/assembly controls on the negative side.
- Public evidence on **party-internal discipline** and day-to-day inter-ministerial coordination is especially thin, so that part of the judgment remains inferred rather than directly observed.
